verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party Consent Management feature for capturing consent under GDPR and CCPA. Its compliance toolkit claims to continuously capture and sync consent preferences downstream to every tool, which covers the capture and propagation halves of the story. The evidence is marketing-level taglines and does not show consent categories gating delivery to specific destinations or opt-outs automatically blocking events. Missing for 10: documented per-destination enforcement by consent category, explicit automatic opt-out suppression behavior, CMP integration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
